_comment: Loan-success-score component weights, per position. Unlike data/score_weights.json (permanent transfers), there's no value_for_money or resale_profit component: most loans carry no real fee (the packaged fee is 0 even when a real loan fee was agreed - see fetch_transfer_types.py), and a loan doesn't end in a sale of its own. playing_time is weighted heavily across every position - whether the loan actually delivered game time is usually the central question a loan gets judged on, independent of how well the player performed when they did play - so it was trimmed only modestly to make room for rating/attacking/defensive/possession (the same FotMob components as permanent transfers - see compute_fotmob_component_pcts in build_dataset.py), which mostly came out of perf_level/perf_delta/value_growth instead. Each FotMob component is only known for the loans FotMob has tenure stats for (scripts/fetch_fotmob_stats.py, same fetch as permanent transfers) - its weight is dropped and the rest renormalized for a loan missing it, same pattern as data/score_weights.json. Shared by scripts/build_dataset.py (computes the label) and app/main.py (labels the 'why this score' explanation). Each position row must sum to 1.0.
